name: CHEM 2443
title: Organic Chemistry
description: Structure and reactions of the simpler classes of the compounds of carbon.
requirement_description: CHEM 1128Q, 1138Q, 1148Q, or 1126Q (1126Q may be taken concurrently). Only two credits after passing CHEM 2241. May not be taken out of sequence after passing CHEM 2444, 2446, or 4370. Repeat restrictions apply; see advising.uconn.edu/repeat-policy for more information.
